integrity: Theorem proved by an explicit Alexander-dual elementary-collapse argument and integral duality; computations are independently replayable finite examples, not the proof for infinite graph families. Previously known Euler correction and special cases are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected graphs with n >= 9 and girth >= 5; ordinary four-cut complexes only. No shellability, natural equivariant equivalence, or claims for graphs with triangles/squares or n <= 8.
title: Homotopy classification of four-cut complexes at the pentagonal girth boundary
